name: Slayer Ghostly Assassin
body:
The slayer is known for hunting their prey, observing their patterns, and using that information to take them down easier. Ghostly assassins eschew that observation and preparation for training in abilities to better surprise their foes and terrify observers. Some ghostly assassins accentuate the fear they induce by wearing terrifying masks of spirits or demons.

Ghost Step (Su)

Beginning at 1st level, as a swift action the ghostly assassin can become invisible per the spell invisibility for 1 round. This can be done for a number of rounds equal to the ghostly assassin’s class level per day. This can be ended early as a free action.

Additionally, the ghostly killer can maintain the invisibility as free action if it was active in the previous round.

At 5th level, the ghostly assassin can become invisible for a number of minutes equal to their class level instead of a number of rounds.
At 10th level, the ghostly assassin may choose to gain the benefit of greater invisibility for a number of rounds equal to their class level instead of the normal invisibility for minutes.
At 15th level, the ghostly assassin instead become ethereal for 1 round per class level instead of invisible.
At 20th level, the ghostly assassin can gain the benefit of greater invisibility for a number of minutes equal to their class level or invisibility for a number of hours equal to their class level.

This ability replaces all iterations of studied target.

Terrifier (Ex)

Beginning at 1st level, the ghostly assassin adds 1/2 their class level (minimum 1) to Intimidate checks.

This ability replaces track.

Terrifying Strike (Ex)

At 4th level, if the ghostly assassin makes a successful sneak attack, the target must make a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the ghostly assassin’s class level + their Charisma modifier). On a failure, the ghostly assassin looks like something out of the target’s nightmares. The target is frightened for 1d4 rounds then shaken for 1 round per class level thereafter. On a successful saving throw the target is shaken for 1d4 rounds. This is a mind-affecting, emotion, fear effect.

Beginning at 10th level, the fear becomes deadly. If the target fails their Will saving throw, then they must then make a Fortitude save against the same DC, on a failure the target dies of fear as if affected by the phantasmal killer spell. If the target has Hit Dice that exceeds the ghostly assassin’s class level, they are immune to the instant death part of the ability and are instead treated as succeeding on their Fortitude save.

If the creature dies of fear from this ability, all creatures within 30 feet of the creature who see the attack, not including the initial target, the ghostly assassin, and the ghostly assassin’s allies, must make Will saves (DC equal to the damage done to the victim + the ghostly killer’s Charisma modifier). On a failure they are frightened for 1d4 rounds and shaken for 1 round per class level thereafter, on a successful save, they are shaken for 1d4 rounds.

At 16th level, if the target fails their Will saving throw, they are panicked for 1d4 rounds then frightened for 1 round per class level thereafter.

This ability is usable once per day at 4th level, and one additional time at 10th and 16th levels.

This ability replaces the slayer talents granted at 4th, 10th and 16th levels.

Ghostly Sight (Su)

At 11th level, the ghostly assassin has a constant see invisibility spell effect.

This ability replaces swift tracker and the 12th level slayer talent.

Terrifying Cleave (Ex)

Beginning at 14th level, if the ghostly assassin reduces a target below 0 hit points with a terrifying strike, whether by the normal damage or the killing effect, they may make an attack at their highest base attack bonus on another creature within reach. If the target is also subject to a sneak attack, they are also subject to the terrifying strike ability without needing to expend another use.

This ability replaces quarry and improved quarry.

Death in the Dark (Ex)

At 20th level, if a target is killed by the frightening effect of their terrifying strike or reduced to less than 0 hit points by a sneak attack, the ghostly assassin regains a number rounds or other duration units of their ghost step ability equal to the Hit Dice of the target, up to their maximum number of rounds per day.

This ability replaces master slayer.
